Messages.Author: jbur...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Greetings All,

This is far from scientific, but I thought I would post the
rarity breakdown on the box of Sabbat War that I bought. Here
goes:

# of Vampires per pack (36 packs total):

2 packs with only 1 vampires
16 packs with 2 vampires
3 packs with 3 vampires
15 packs with 4 vampires

Total cards and rarities:

(I had to make a number of assumptions here:
The top card in every booster is rare.
The next 4 cards are the uncommon slots.
They should hold 3 uncommon cards and 1 vampire.
The last 6 cards are the common slots.
They should hold 1 vampire and 5 commons.)

36 rare cards
73 uncommon cards
182 common cards
71 uncommon vampires
34 common vampires

396 total cards

# of doubles

0 rare doubles
21 uncommon doubles
17 uncommon vampire doubles
70 common doubles
14 common vampire doubles

122 total doubles

# of triples

0 rare triples
1 uncommon triples
2 uncommon vampire triples
14 common triples
2 common vampire triples

19 total triples

Distinct cards:

36 rare cards
50 uncommon cards
44 uncommon vampires
84 common cards
16 common vampires

230 total distinct cards

At first I was disapointed with getting 31 extra vampires
in my box instead of uncommon cards, but after looking at
everything it seems like things were pretty well balanced.
Also, it possible that I would have just gotten more repeats
on uncommon cards (it looks like there's a U3 and U1
distribution, with any hunting grounds being U3 - I got a
bunch of doubles here), so perhaps getting the extra vamps
wasn't so bad (with the 4 starter decks that I got I almost
have all the vampires). Finally, it also looks like there
are a number of commons that were printed in the starters
but aren't in the boosters (though the skill cards aren't
one of those =), and since I doubled up on every common I'm
lead to believe that the commons I got in the box represent
all the commons in the set, but I'll have to take a closer
look at my lists before I'll know for sure.

I'm not sure if this is useful to anyone, but I wanted to
see just how bad the printing distribution got messed up.
Right now (atleast until I get a full list that shows what
reprints are actually in the set) I'm pretty pleased.

Sincerely,

Jason Burke
Newbie Prince of St. Louis
jburke at luci dot org

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

They are. The rarities for the vampires (Common or Uncommon) are now
available on the White Wolf web page.

Each pack was supposed to have 6 commons (1 vamp and 5 library), 4 uncommon
(2 vamp and 2 library) and 1 rare (a library card).

While the rarities are preserved (6/4/1), the occurance of the vampires can
be 0,1, or 2 common and between 0 and 4 uncommon.
